transcript.text: hoover washer drier showing EO3 wont drain, ive done the filter its clean. H3DS4965DACE. pump just buzzes. do i need a new pump??

I can't confirm what EO3 means on your model, so I'll go by what it is doing. From what you have described, the most likely cause is drain pump (jammed or failed). With the filter out, shine a torch into the filter opening and gently turn the small plastic impeller (the vanes) with a finger. Does it turn freely, was anything caught in it, is it jammed, or do the vanes look broken?
turned it by finger with power off and it spins totally freely, no resistance at all, feels like its not connected to anything. torch shows one fin looks snapped

[Heading: Likely cause: drain pump (jammed or failed)]
The checks point to the drain pump (jammed or failed). I could not find a confirmed match for model H3DS4965DACE in our parts catalogue, so check with the manufacturer or a parts supplier using the full model number, or ask an appliance engineer to fit it.
